treatments.narration: Nearly twenty years later, Guy Fawkes became infamous in York as part of the Gunpowder Plot to blow up Parliament.
Historians theorise that Fawkes may have witnessed Margaret Clitherow's execution nineteen years earlier.
Christopher and John Wright also knew her story.
Her brutal death may have shaped their thinking before the 1605 plot.
